other_unreachable.item: An ask beyond the area manager's 100 bps
other_unreachable.reason: The band is [card - 60 bps, card], narrower than her 100 bps, so the policy floor always binds first
A rate request is a request for a lower rate; going above the recommendation is the area manager's uplift, never above the matrix rate
